content.short: Symbiosis is a multi-chain liquidity protocol that aggregates exchange liquidity across EVM and selected non-EVM networks.
content.description: Symbiosis is a multi-chain liquidity protocol that aggregates exchange liquidity across EVM networks and select non-EVM ecosystems, including TRON, Bitcoin, and BNB. By unifying liquidity across disparate bridges and swap platforms, it enables asset swaps and cross-chain liquidity transfers with a single click and a single on-chain transaction, helping to reduce fragmentation and streamline multi-chain trading. This simple setup aims to reduce fragmentation across bridges and swap platforms.
